title: Town population, need tiers, and growth knobs

demandPerNeedPerMonth.description: Units a need must receive in a month to be fully met, by need level: 1 raw, 2 processed, 3 finished. Each must be at least 1.

populationPerPartlyMetNeed.description: Inhabitants gained each month per partly met need (at least 1 unit but less than the demand delivered), by need level: 1 raw, 2 processed, 3 finished. Cannot exceed the fully met amount.

populationPerFullyMetNeed.description: Inhabitants gained each month per fully met need (the demand delivered), by need level.

allNeedsMetGrowthMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the month's total growth when every unlocked need is fully met.

passengersPerPopulationUnit.description: Population divisor for passengers generated each production pulse (at least 1 when population > 0).

mailPerPopulationUnit.description: Population divisor for mail generated each production pulse (0 when population is below the unit).

passengerWaitingCapacity.description: Max passenger-class units waiting at a town (excess generation is wasted).

minTownsPerNeededCargo.description: How many towns must plan each level 1-3 freight cargo as a need; generation adds towns until this holds.

names.description: Unique town names (real-world capitals) picked per map from the seed; must cover the largest town count.
